name: quarkus-service
runtime: Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4 on Java 21 (UBI 9)
description: Starter: a Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4 service on Java 21 (Red Hat Maven BOM 3.33.4.redhat-00003, Quarkus REST) with a page about itself, /health, /api/info and /api/connections, and a Dockerfile that builds and runs it on Red Hat UBI 9 OpenJDK 21 images. Deployed with deployment rules such as k8s-deploy.
